recentItems.title: South Koreans protest navy expansion near Strait of Hormuz amid Iran war fears
recentItems.description:
South Korea is considering whether to extend its anti-piracy operations from the Gulf of Aden to the Gulf of Oman. 
This will put its navy close to the Strait of Hormuz.
Critics at home say this could draw South Korea into the war with Iran.

Al Jazeera’s Jack Barton reports from Seoul, South Korea.

recentItems.title: Zelenskyy says US gave no warning before Russian missile attack on Kyiv
recentItems.description:
Ukraine's president says his country received no warning from its allies before a Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv.
Volodymr Zelenskyy says Moscow launched 16 missiles and more than 200 drones overnight, killing one person and injuring several others.
More than 10 energy facilities were damaged, along with a metro station, a medical facility and other buildings.
Ukraine relies on a US early warning system to help it prepare for incoming Russian ballistic missile attacks.

Al Jazeera’s Audrey MacAlpine reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.

recentItems.title: Houthi missiles strike military base in Yemen, killing at least 18
recentItems.description:
Ansar Allah Houthi ballistic missiles have struck a military base, killing at least 18 people. 
The base is in al-Jawf district in northern Yemen that is under part government control but majority Houthi control. 
The Yemen military spokesman says three ballistic missiles hit a training centre for security and police personnel
They say more than 30 people have been wounded. 

Al Jazeera’s Yousef Mawry reports from Yemen's capital, Sanaa

recentItems.title: France’s Macron kicks off Gulf tour in Kuwait eyeing Strait of Hormuz security
recentItems.description:
French President Emmanuel Macron has arrived in Kuwait kicking off a three-day tour of Gulf countries.
Macron is the first French President to visit Kuwait in more than 17 years.
Talks are expected to focus on defence and infrastructure. 
He'll also be visiting the UAE, Bahrain and Qatar.
Discussions there will include keeping the critical Strait of Hormuz open. 

Al Jazeera’s Ali Hashem reports from Doha, Qatar.
